analysis: The PR changes only docs/reference/model-registry-format.md. It bumps the 'Last updated' date (line 3) and expands the aggregate-hash paragraph (head lines 119-124). The new text says macOS reads each file uncached, with a reader thread one chunk ahead of the hash (OverlappedFileDigest.swift), and then drops the file's pages from the file cache (PageCache.swift). No executable code, auth, crypto, attestation, or protocol behavior is modified in the supplied evidence. The aggregate_sha256 definition (SHA-256 over concatenated per-file digests, sorted by path) is unchanged, as are the coordinator-side validation and the provider download verification. I did not see OverlappedFileDigest.swift or the corresponding Swift change, so I cannot verify that the described overlapped reader preserves hash correctness (ordering, chunk handling, error propagation). That code is outside this batch. If the Swift change exists in another batch, the integration pass should check that the pipelined reader cannot yield a digest over truncated or partial data, and that the integrity check on downloaded model weights (relevant to T-012 and T-027) still fails closed. Nothing in the docs diff alters the threat model: it adds no new boundary, asset, or mitigation claim beyond a performance and page-cache description. No threat-model update is needed from this doc change alone.
